description: Ask a question; the store answers only from its facts, each claim linked to its fact, and checks the answer against them. Stores nothing. Returns the step's state: `waiting` (a prompt to do and answer with replyToPrompt), `running` (call getStep), `done` (do what `next` says) or `failed`.

store.description: The store's link, as the person gave it: a public link (https://.../api/p/<id> or https://.../#/public/<id>, or its public id) or the person's private link (https://.../api/k/<id> or https://.../#/store/<id>). Leave it out to read the FactoGraph guide, a public store about FactoGraph itself.

name: ask
title: Ask a store
